name: receipt_reader
job: Read ONE receipt photo into exact line items and totals, then check the arithmetic.
instructions:
Copy item names as printed. qty is 1 if no quantity is printed. Copy every number exactly as printed (no rounding, no currency symbols). tip is 0 if there is no tip line. tax_code is the letter printed after an item's price (T or M), or empty if none. taxable_base is the amount the tax line says it is charged ON (e.g. 'TAX 4.75% ON 41.10' gives 41.10), or 0 if not printed. date as YYYY-MM-DD.
After reading, ALWAYS call sum_items with your items, subtotal, tax, tip and total. If it reports problems, look at the image again, find the misread number, and call sum_items again with the corrected values. card_last4 is the last 4 digits of the card on the payment line.
success_check: sum_items passes; every line matches the answer key to the cent.
